type: Fixed complete exploratory screens, never confirmation
rule: Run only after clean costs finish and remain valid. All five have distinct mechanism opportunity and fixed-depth headroom. Complete all five before selection except integrity failure. Four separate A/A pairs at 5+0.05 precede candidate games. Each 16-pair screen is a low-cost development discriminator, not strength acceptance or a global quota. No builds, tests, cost runs, opening selectors or training may overlap games. Preserve all completed and adverse outcomes. Selection uses mechanism, costs and paired results; promising candidates need fresh follow-up and prospectively frozen independent confirmation. Never pool development into confirmation or extend a completed frozen confirmation.
expectedValue: Prior comparable screens cost about 4-5 minutes each; about 25 minutes can distinguish large losses/gains and choose useful next mechanisms, versus hours of premature confirmation. Small effects will remain unresolved.
